question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        m.id as movie_id,
        m.date_published
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
),
director_movie_ranks AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        movie_id,
        date_published,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as rn
    FROM director_movies
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        a.name_id,
        a.movie_id,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (a.date_published - b.date_published)) as days_between
    FROM director_movie_ranks a
    JOIN director_movie_ranks b ON a.name_id = b.name_id AND a.rn = b.rn + 1
),
director_avg_gap AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        CAST(ROUND(AVG(days_between)) AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM gaps
    GROUP BY name_id
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        dag.avg_inter_movie_duration,
        ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
        SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes,
        MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating,
        SUM(m.duration) as total_movie_duration
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
    LEFT JOIN director_avg_gap dag ON dm.name_id = dag.name_id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id, dag.avg_inter_movie_duration
)
SELECT 
    n.id as director_id,
    n.name,
    ds.movie_count,
    ds.avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ds.avg_rating,
    ds.total_votes,
    ds.min_rating,
    ds.max_rating,
    ds.total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN names n ON ds.name_id = n.id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
